messages:
support-ops: customer ticket INC-5421 — decrypt failures after key rotation for tenant prod-12. Seeing AccessDenied / InvalidCiphertext intermittently. CloudTrail shows no KMS Decrypt events for 2026-02-23T14:03-14:10Z for those request IDs. Can we triage? :eyes:
josh: can you paste sample request ids + key alias? region? also any proxy in front of KMS?
support-ops: region us-east-1, key alias alias/tenant-prod-12-kms, sample request_id abc123, def456. Proxy: internal kms-proxy service (v1.5.1 deployed 2026-02-23T14:00Z). Customer says spike in billed attempts too.
elena: quick check — if proxy strips or mutates EncryptionContext we will get AccessDenied or InvalidCiphertext depending on backend key. Can you share the raw proxy logs around abc123?
josh: snippet from proxy logs:
```
[2026-02-23T14:04:12Z] REQUEST id=abc123 endpoint=/decrypt body={"ciphertext":"...","encryption_context":null} auth=role:svc-kms-proxy
[2026-02-23T14:04:12Z] KMS_CALL id=abc123 key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-efgh
[2026-02-23T14:04:12Z] KMS_RESPONSE id=abc123 error=AccessDeniedException: EncryptionContext mismatch
```
josh: note that the customer SDK always sends enc ctx; proxy log shows null — looks like a regression in v1.5.1 that normalizes headers.
deploy-bot: kms-proxy v1.5.1 deployed by jenkins at 2026-02-23T13:59:47 :rocket:
sre-bot: alert: 3xx increase in KMS Decrypt error rate observed starting 2026-02-23T14:02 UTC, correlated with kms-proxy rollout.
maria: from compliance: missing CloudTrail entries for Decrypt are concerning for retention/audit. We need to know whether requests never reached AWS KMS (proxy dropped ctx) or KMS rejected with no audit record. If the latter, export all proxy call traces and forward to security-SIEM. Also we need key policy and grants for alias/tenant-prod-12-kms.
elena: confirm plan: 1) collect full raw proxy traces for 14:00-14:15 2) run local reproduction hitting kms-proxy with and without encryption_context 3) rollback kms-proxy to v1.4.3 as mitigation if confirmed 4) check IAM role used by proxy has kms:Decrypt with Condition on kms:EncryptionContext keys.
josh: reproduction steps (internal):
```
# reproduce (from instance in prod VPC)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/decrypt -d '{"ciphertext":"...","encryption_context":{"tenant_id":"prod-12","request_id":"repro001"}}'
# proxied request logged -> encryption_context present
# now send without context
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/decrypt -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}'
# proxy logs show encryption_context:null -> KMS returns AccessDenied
```
maria: please also capture the AWS CloudTrail filter for KMS events: `eventName=Decrypt` and the time window. If CloudTrail lacks entries while proxy shows KMS_CALL attempts, that suggests proxy never invoked KMS. If CloudTrail has entries with error, we have an audit record. We need this for compliance ticket C-987.
josh: checked CloudTrail — for abc123 there's no Decrypt event, but proxy log indicates a KMS_CALL line (we log call intent before actual AWS SDK call). Looks like the proxy didn't call AWS SDK after validation failed.
elena: likely regression: input validation path returns early and increments billing metrics (we record attempted decrypt for billing) but didn't call AWS. That would explain billed attempts + missing trail. We need a hotfix: restore propagation of encryption_context to AWS SDK call and ensure we only count billed attempts on successful outbound call.
support-ops: customer reachable for a scheduled maintenance window in 30m, propose rollback then.
maria: for audit retention question: snapshot current SIEM ingestion for that window and annotate ticket. Also we need the KMS key policy check — josh can you paste `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/tenant-prod-12-kms` output (sanitized)?
josh: sanitized policy fragment:
```
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/svc-kms-proxy"},"Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:tenant_id":"prod-12"}}}]}
```
elena: good — key policy enforces encryption context. If proxy removes context, KMS would reject; but we'd still expect a Decrypt event in CloudTrail if the SDK contacted KMS. Because there is no CloudTrail entry, fix must be in proxy before outbound.
josh: hotfix branch open, patch ensures ctx forwarded to AWS SDK and only increments metric after AWS SDK call returns. I'll cut a 1.5.2 build now. :warning:
elena: after deploy of 1.5.2, run a controlled repro with customer. If rollback chosen, do v1.4.3 rollback and note potential config drift.
support-ops: assigning incident INC-5421 -> escalation to eng-security + kms-team. Notifying customer we have mitigation plan and ETA ~45m. :thumbsup:
maria: after mitigation, we need a compliance summary: timeline, root cause, data retention impact, list of affected tenant request_ids, and confirmation of CloudTrail exports. I'll own the postmortem section for compliance. :lock:
